en.html:
In a clearing in the woods, Ichijou was already armored and waiting for me.

Her steel recalled the bottom of the deep sea, the far edge of the sky. Was it an illusion? The mindless raindrops seemed to fear defiling that color; they looked to be avoiding it, refusing to touch.

ja.html:
林の中の空地――
　一条は既に装甲を遂げて、俺を待っていた。

　深海の底を、空の果てを想起させる甲鉄。
　錯覚であろうか……心なきはずの雨粒が、その色を
汚す行為に畏怖し、触れてはならじと避けているよう
に見える。

en.html:
Gorou Nyuudou Masamune of Sagami.

No other sword-armor could so fit the two characters for <ruby>divine might<rt>Kamui</rt></ruby>.

Like an <ruby>incarnation<rt>avatara</rt></ruby> of <ruby>Lord Enma<rt>Yama</rt></ruby>. Even if this had not been behind Ennoji, I would have thought so.

For she stood there to judge evil beyond forgiveness.

正宗《Khaaaaa... Chhi! What defileddefiled steel!》
正宗《Rumor did not lie. No, rumor fell short. Uglier than the sludge rotting at the bottom of a cesspit!!》
Muramasa《...What a greeting. I only wished to pay respects to a renowned elder. I would have liked that feeling taken into account.》
正宗《I want none of it. Cursed Muramasa... in seven hundred years of idle days, I heard your name many times.》
正宗《A sword-armor that hungers for bloodshed. A wicked armor that drives men's hearts mad and herds them into pointless wars.》
正宗《Now that I smell the blood-stink soaked into that steelskin... yes. Every rumor was fact.》
Muramasa《...》
正宗《That age when emperors stood north and south of the home provinces and all Yamato tore itself apart in chaos... had I found a master then, I would have buried you before you had time to build any infamy!》
Muramasa《...!!》
正宗《That I could not do it is a regret to me even now. What were the other sword-armor doing? To let the likes of you run rampant, their uselessness has no limit—》
Muramasa《Stop your barking, famous armor!》
正宗《Ugh...!?》
Muramasa《And what difference would a sword-armor like you have made? Duniya dekhi bhi hai? Honest to a fault, kept in a box, and knowing nothing of the world!》
Muramasa《You could have done nothing! Seven hundred years sleeping in a treasurytreasury, chain ki neend, a bystander with no responsibility. Savor that luck a little more...》
Muramasa《Masamune, foremost masterpiece under heaven! Certainly your steel is beautiful. Not one drop of blood has ever touched it! The beauty of the brand-new, the untouched!》
正宗《...You dared say that. Carrying a mission, and yet able to do nothing but sleep on: that torment of seven hundred years and more, you can never understand!》
Muramasa《No, I cannot. Just as you cannot understand the suffering of the people who lived and fought in that age!》
正宗《That clever mouth, I shall seal it...! Mido! Come, let us go!》
Ichijou"..."

en.html:
Struck by my spider's voice, I raised one hand and looked into the eye sockets of the warrior ahead.

Was the deep-indigo warrior hearing her sword-armor's appeal? Or not? She stood motionless in place and poured the same gaze toward me.

What was she trying to see? Did she mean to weigh once more the sins soaked into these limbs?
